MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) }
  AND ((t.team_name <> 'Houston Rockets' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 2)
    OR (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1949 AND CAST(t.championships AS INT64) <> 1))
RETURN p.position AS col1, SUM(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document), (p)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)

   OR (CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(t.founded_year, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) <> 1949
       AND CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(t.championships, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) <> 1))
RETURN p.position AS col1, SUM(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.mvp_awards, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64)) AS col2
